passages.text: Assume positive intent in one interaction today

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Genuinely consider you might be wrong about something important

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Express one piece of your potential in action today, however small

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Take one concrete action on a pattern you've been 'aware of' for months

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Pause for 3 breaths between trigger and response

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Stay present with one uncomfortable situation instead of leaving

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: When frozen, wiggle toes and fingers to come back to body

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Hold one boundary in a power-dynamic situation

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Share something you've been hoarding

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Say no to one request today — just 'no' with no explanation

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Accept help with one small thing today

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: For every catastrophe thought, generate one equally likely positive scenario

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Extend small trust and track the actual outcome

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Be alone for 1 hour and notice you survive and are okay

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Share the shame with one safe person — shame dies in the light

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Ask yourself: 'Is this actually rejection, or is it just not about me?'

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Ground in present: 'I am an adult, this is now, I am safe'

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Make a deliberate small mistake and observe: nothing catastrophic happens

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: After a mistake, treat yourself with the compassion you'd give a friend

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Allow yourself to receive gentle love without suspecting it

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Watch something moving and let whatever comes come, even one tear

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Take up more space than usual in one setting today
